summary:
Updated implementation plan documenting:
- Diagnosis and permanent resolution of the 'Failed to parse APK' error: ephemeral web public/ directory was missing the APK binary (yielding 404 HTML), and .build-outputs had an incomplete archive. Both public/DocFlow.apk and public/app-debug.apk are now populated with the complete 314MB APK verified by apksigner v2 and aapt2 badging.
- Addition of success toasts and snackbar notifications across all PDF export entry points (ToolsScreen conversionSuccess LaunchedEffect, DocumentViewerScreen saveLauncher & exportPdfLauncher, DocumentViewerEditorScreen note export, bulk version/note export, watermark export, and VersionHistorySheet).
- Added responsive public/index.html web download portal with SHA-256 integrity details and Android installation instructions.
